name: claude-workspace-superengine
description: Workspace lifecycle superengine. Scaffolds new workspaces with the canonical eight-file scheme (RULES.md / CLAUDE.md / ARCHITECTURE.md / GOALS.md / PLANNING.md / MEMORY.md / Checkpoint.md / handoff.md), reads them at session start, and writes durable handoffs at session end. Built on top of agent-optimizer's four override constraints.
